title: Statistics South Africa – Official National Data and Insights Portal
description:
the official online portal of South Africa’s national statistics agency, which collects, analyses and disseminates comprehensive data about the country’s people, economy, society and environment to support informed decision‑making by government, businesses and the public. It publishes official statistics on topics like population, employment, inflation, trade, and living conditions, offers data tools and interactive visuals, and provides access to reports, surveys and census results

Price: $2,000 | Size: 154 GB | Records: 453 362 Files | Dump date: 2026
